limitations: Unrelated compilation/test jobs were active on the host; small changes and absolute timings are inconclusive.
Profiles use 20,000 retained rays against a trivial surface; capture windows are late in the recording.
Synchronized includes caller fixture, IMU synthesis and scoring; no native dynamics or ROS.
ROS metadata benchmark excludes field population, DDS publication and subscribers.
MuJoCo allocation experiment was not retained; measured candidate SHA differs from restored production.

profiles.protocol: Case-level serial alternating baseline/candidate; three outer pairs, each two warmups and ten inner trials; host had unrelated compilation/test load; small deltas inconclusive. Default release flags, no CPU pinning.

synchronized.protocol: Five serial alternating baseline/candidate runs, 20 articulated packets each, 7.8125 ms chunks, acquisition+IMU+scoring; no ROS/native physics/GPU; unrelated host load present.

ros_metadata.protocol: Two warmups then ten alternating-order trials of 1,000 empty messages per type; libraries preloaded; native ROS C interfaces; no DDS endpoints.

mujoco_experiment.protocol: Two warmups then seven alternating-order trials; static two-box scene; no physics stepping, ROS or GPU.
mujoco_experiment.decision: Rejected: no useful short-call timing gain; retained scratch costs up to 11.2 MB. Production restored to baseline; stronger native tests retained.
